description: EscapeStays is the direct booking site of Luxury Lodging, a professional property manager with about 250 vacation rental homes across the United States. Search homes by place, dates, guests, bedrooms, pets and amenities; check live availability; get a real stay total that already includes cleaning, fees and taxes; and compare up to five homes side by side. Every result shows the home's neighbourhood, its own check-in time, deposit, pet policy and house rules, and its 4- and 5-star guest reviews from Airbnb and Booking.com, each labelled with its source. Prices are the manager's own, with no online travel agency commission added. The plugin never books for you: when you have chosen a stay it gives you a link to finish checkout, pay by card or Link, and accept the rental terms on Luxury Lodging's own site.
